app.name: Trustline
app.tagline: Quality, risk and incident management for hospitals

shell.signOutFailed: Could not sign out. Try again.
shell.sessionError: Could not reach the server. Reload the page.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: What needs attention across incidents, actions and policies.

reportIncident.title: Report an incident
reportIncident.description: Report an incident, near miss or hazard. It should take under two minutes.

modulePage.notBuilt: This area is not available yet.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.description: Incidents, near misses and hazards, from report to closure.
scope: Reporting by any employee, with an anonymous option and QR codes
Triage and routing to the responsible departments
Response deadlines with escalation, and feedback to the reporter

investigations.title: Investigations
investigations.description: Investigation and root cause analysis for serious events.
scope: Investigation team, timeline, interviews and evidence
5 Whys, fishbone diagram and contributing factors
Root cause analysis report with approval

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: One tracker for every corrective and preventive action.
scope: Actions from incidents, investigations, risks and policies in one place
Owners, due dates, evidence and escalation
Effectiveness checks after an action is completed

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: One library of current, approved policies and procedures.
scope: Templates, numbering and version history
Configurable approval cycles with electronic signature
Periodic review reminders and staff acknowledgement

risks.title: Risks
risks.description: Risk registers for the organization and each department.
scope: Enterprise and department registers
Configurable 5×5 risk matrix and heat maps
Controls, reviews, and incidents linked to risks

training.title: Training
training.description: Proof that staff were trained, with their signature.
scope: Courses, sessions and awareness campaigns
Signed attendance, quizzes and certificates with expiry
Required training by role, and compliance by department

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Dashboards and reports for leadership and committees.
scope: Role-based dashboards and trends
Standard reports with Excel and PDF export
Scheduled reports by email

organization.title: Organization
scope: The organization's structure, in English and Arabic
Locations used for reporting and routing
Department owners and escalation contacts

users.title: Users and roles
users.description: Who can sign in and what they can do.
scope: Accounts created by an administrator, or at first single sign-on
Roles and permissions per department and facility
Access reviews and the audit trail of changes

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: How Trustline is configured for this organization.
scope: Accreditation standard, languages and branding
Incident categories, forms and approval workflows
Sign-in by password or single sign-on, and notifications
